integrity: Complete article, review, verification notes and standalone standard-library finite checker embedded with explicit byte counts and SHA-256 digest per file.
scientific_limitations: Exact support profiles for open neighborhoods of complete rectangular rook graphs only. The proof of no four-point shattering invokes the previously published Hamming-graph theorem. No claim of historical priority without independent external verification.
title: Exact open-neighborhood shattering polynomials of rectangular rook graphs
